# SYNESIS_E102 — Error

## Description

`field_name`: empty item in the list.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The list in the field `field_name` has an empty item (two commas
  in a row, or a comma at the start or end). Remove the extra comma.
```
